verdict.rationale: Raygun has an official MCP server (raygun-probe-3) and API access (external access token, export feature) that could expose top issues with full stack traces, environment, and prioritization data (raygun-docs-1, raygun-docs-3, raygun-docs-8, raygun-docs-9). However, there is no evidence of a documented mechanism for filing bugs into external trackers (e.g., Jira, GitHub Issues) via API/MCP — the only outbound integrations shown are Slack/PagerDuty notifications and source-control links for source maps, not issue creation, and no OpenAPI spec is discoverable (raygun-probe-2). missing for 10: explicit tracker/issue-filing integration via API or MCP, and a documented end-to-end triage-to-filing workflow.
